verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an incorporation and compliance service, but no first-party evidence shows Atlas filing Delaware annual reports or franchise tax for founders. Community posts mention franchise tax bills arising from the share structure, with 'no warnings', and say state-level legwork is left to founders. One vague remark about filing 2017 taxes does not establish annual-report or franchise-tax filing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can file annual reports and franchise tax on time through the platform
